node.label: Elevated urine mevalonic acid level
node.definition: An abnormally increased amount of mevanolate in the urine. Mevanolate is that hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mevalonic acid.

evidence.snippet: Hyper-Igd syndrome: Elevated urine mevalonic acid level (frequency 33/33) [PCS]
